name: OKC_K_ART_VARIABLES
description: Document clause variable table. This will store clause variables used in a document through contract term

columns.name: CAT_ID
columns.description: It refers to the contract clause id. Part of the Primary Key.

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Major Version Number of the Contract Clause Variable

columns.name: VERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Version Type of the Object. It can have following values "C"urrent , "A"mendment and "H"istory.

columns.name: VARIABLE_CODE
columns.description: Variable Code for the Clause variable used

columns.name: VARIABLE_TYPE
columns.description: Variable Type of the Clause variable used

columns.name: EXTERNAL_YN
columns.description: Flag to identify whether the data entry be to allowed for external users

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_SET_ID
columns.description: Value Set Id of variables. The value for the variable will be sourced from this fnd value set

columns.name: VARIABLE_VALUE_ID
columns.description: It refers to the id of the variable value. It applies to the LOVs and Choice Lists.

columns.name: VARIABLE_VALUE
columns.description: It refers to the value of the variable . It applies to free format.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_GLOBAL_YN
columns.description: Indicator to show whether the global value is overridden or not

columns.name: GLOBAL_VARIABLE_VALUE
columns.description: Stores value for global variable. This column is used for UI manipulations

columns.name: GLOBAL_VARIABLE_VALUE_ID
columns.description: Stores id value for global variable. This column is used for UI manipulations

columns.name: AMENDMENT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: It describes the amendment operation.

columns.name: AMENDMENT_OPERATION_CODE
columns.description: It describes the amendment operation code, Values are "ADDED", "DELETED","UPDATED"

columns.name: SUMMARY_AMEND_OPERATION_CODE
columns.description: It describes the summary amendment operation code, Values are "ADDED", "DELETED","UPDATED"
